name: BT134
description: A 4A sensitive-gate triac for general-purpose AC switching and phase control. Comes in the SOT82 package (TO-126-like flat tab, but not JEDEC TO-126). The tab is electrically MT2.

pins.name: T2
pins.description: main terminal 2 (MT2); tied to the mounting tab

SOT-82.notes: SOT82 package (NXP/Philips), front face toward you and leads down: pin 1 (T1), pin 2 (T2/tab), pin 3 (G) left to right. Tab = MT2, not isolated.

extra.quadrants: four; Q4 (T2-, G+) is the weakest

typical_application: Bidirectional AC on/off and phase control: motor, lighting, and heating loads needing high blocking voltage and a sensitive gate.
gotchas: package is SOT-82, NOT JEDEC TO-126; the footprint is similar but the designation differs
the tab is electrically MT2 (pin 2) and is not isolated; the heatsink sits at MT2 potential
Q4 (MT2-, gate+) is the weakest trigger quadrant; do not rely on it for low gate drive
